results.title: Ananda Roy
results.content: Circana’s Liquid Data Go® solution helps emerging and mid-sized CPG brands show their value. Monitoring the impact of macroeconomic factors, including tariffs, on volume, price, and supply on U.S. consumer behavior within the CPG Industry. Ananda Roy engages executive leaders at the world’s largest consumer goods brands and retailers on the strategic drivers of category growth. Roy is the author of several Circana European CPG thought leadership reports, including Europe’s Innovation Pacesetters, Sustainability Matters: No Plan B, Private Labels: Hiding in Plain Sight, and Demand Signals, Circana’s bi-annual consumer goods categoryreview. Circana has tracked foodservice data for 50 years, and consumers have been following various diet plans for the entirety of that time. How to Use Consumer Data to Stand Out and Drive Growth in a Saturated Market. Circana to launch UK consumer tech and home appliances market measurement service in 2026. Three Principles of Consumer Behavior for Increasing Brand Equity and Market Growth.
